extraction_rules.optimization_energy: Read stdout as UTF-8 text, track GEOMETRY OPTIMIZATION CYCLE integer; collect FINAL SINGLE POINT ENERGY tokens up to THE OPTIMIZATION HAS CONVERGED. For each cycle keep the last such token. Any energy after convergence is separately labelled final_evaluation. These two archives each contain exactly one FINAL SINGLE POINT ENERGY per numbered cycle, followed by one post-convergence final evaluation.
extraction_rules.relative_energy: (Decimal(energy_token) - Decimal(post-convergence final energy_token)) * 1000 in mEh. This is relative to that molecule and method only, not an accuracy error.
extraction_rules.hessian_frequency: Read $vibrational_frequencies block: declared dimension then exactly N index/token rows. Preserve tokens. Indices 0–5 are explicitly projected rigid modes; remaining 3N–6 entries are vibrational candidates under the stored nonlinear policy. Both archives have six zeros and all remaining entries positive.
extraction_rules.runtime: Parse single TOTAL RUN TIME from each stdout, convert days/hours/minutes/seconds/msec to seconds. This reports ORCA internal elapsed wall time, not workflow or human end-to-end time.
